authors: Valentin Šimundić; Luka Petrović; Matej Džijan; Robert Cupec
relevance_reason: This paper gives an explicit F/T–tactile division: wrist F/T detects unexpected collisions globally, while a fingertip tactile sensor verifies local door-leaf contact and contact loss.
